$comment: CMake presets: named configure/build settings so nobody has to remember
long command lines. Usage: `cmake --preset debug`, then
`cmake --build --preset debug`. VS Code CMake Tools and CLion read this
file and list the presets in a dropdown.
This file is optional. Without it, the equivalent command is
Schema version 10 (CMake 3.31+) is needed for these $comment fields.

configurePresets.$comment: Day-to-day development: no optimization, debug symbols, asserts enabled.
configurePresets.name: debug

configurePresets.name: release

$comment: Release build containing both Apple Silicon and Intel code in one
binary. Only needed when distributing the plugin to others.
configurePresets.name: release-universal

configurePresets.name: xcode

buildPresets.$comment: Each build preset points at a configure preset so `cmake --build --preset <name>` knows which build folder to use.
buildPresets.name: debug

buildPresets.$comment: Xcode projects hold every configuration, so the build preset picks one.
